description: This Java class defines mapping strategies for handling message command response signals within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. It maps signal types to corresponding JsonifiableMapper implementations that generate response objects based on adaptable signals.

classes.name: MessageCommandResponseMappingStrategies
classes.description: Defines singleton pattern based class for mapping strategies that map message command response types to their JsonifiableMapper implementations within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MessageCommandResponseMappingStrategies.

methods.name: initMappingStrategies
methods.description: Initializes the mapping of signal type strings to their respective JsonifiableMapper functions for message command responses.

methods.name: featureIdForMessageFrom
methods.description: Extracts the feature ID from the adaptable's payload, throwing JsonParseException if absent.
